name: KDP Production / DSD Operations - Tucson AZ

fieldNotes.location: Roster gave 3401 E Columbia St (32.1727/-110.9171) - that point is a different industrial area ~3 km SE and not the facility. Web research confirms the actual KDP/Kalil site: KDP acquired Kalil Bottling Co.'s Tucson real estate (May/2024 announcement, deal closed Q3 2024) for $8.55M - seven buildings totaling 161,835 sq ft on 7.71 acres at 931 S Highland Ave and 1201-1262 E 19th Street, Tucson AZ 85719 (Real Estate Daily News; Waze lists Kalil Bottling at 931 S Highland Ave). Locked center 32.2108/-110.9514.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The whole complex is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing with gated openings off E 19th St / S Highland Ave. This is a controlled fenced perimeter (counts as a truck gate). However no barrier-arm across a single truck lane was clearly resolved in imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure observed at any gate opening - the fenced openings appear to be unstaffed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - there is a controlled fenced/gated perimeter but no guard shack, implying badge/keypad/remote check-in. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 band. Dock doors visible on the production/warehouse building faces; ~16 estimated. Older compact plant - exact count approximate, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 band. Trailers staged in the central yard plus pallet/crate storage; ~14 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated trailer/pallet staging yard exists within the fenced complex (SW area also holds DSD fleet vehicles).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - the site is a multi-building campus: per the real-estate record it comprises seven buildings (production plant, warehouse, fleet/DSD operations buildings) on one contiguous fenced parcel.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight older-urban site - compact yard, short driveways, and a chain-link gate close to E 19th St; a truck queue would have little internal stacking room and could spill onto the street.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Compact plant - gate-to-dock approach holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks are not on clearly separate ship vs receive banks - single compact dock area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is inside Tucson's dense south-side industrial district, immediately adjacent to Interstate 10. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the parcel (a rail corridor runs nearby through the district but not into this site).
fieldNotes.OVERALL: Confidence MEDIUM: facility positively re-located via the KDP-Kalil real-estate transaction record, but the roster address was wrong, the site is an older compact multi-building complex that is harder to read from overhead, and gate-detail (barrier arm vs open fenced gate, lane counts) could not be fully resolved.
